key_developments: Delta versus prior brief is de-escalation in paper markets but not normalization on the ground: Brent fell from 118.35 to 94.44 after a two-week U.S.-Iran ceasefire framework, yet physical energy and shipping conditions remain stressed.
Israel backed the pause on Iran strikes while explicitly excluding Lebanon, and Reuters plus Guardian reporting showed continued heavy strikes in Lebanon despite the broader ceasefire framework.

Hormuz shifted from outright closure to conditional, permit-based transit only; Reuters reporting indicates shippers still lack clarity, fleets remain stranded or cautious, and Qatar LNG and helium disruption remain unresolved.
